review_method: Opened the actual exported native XCUITest screenshots and inspected the recorded scroll measurements.
observations: Normal-contrast prose, compact tool rows, rendered mathematics/table and an unobstructed composer remain visible after swipe keyboard dismissal.
The detached reader stays on earlier text while generation continues; its jump-to-latest control remains available.
Manual swiping reached following mode while the response was still generating; the latest content remains above the composer.
The recorded reading offset stayed 3442 and the screen anchor stayed -3207 while content grew from 4707 to 4888 points.
The route card contains native map attribution, travel estimate, distance, details and a separate Maps action.
Memory history shows the undo entry and before/after values; foreground recovery retains one user request and continues the saved reply.
The large-type home layout retains its heading and uses a single-column action layout; content remains scrollable.
limits: Synthetic simulator fixtures. These captures do not establish live provider behavior, physical location/LiDAR accuracy, a complete accessibility audit or physical installation.
